proposal.summary: A flaw in the Linux Kernel: tls_is_tx_ready() incorrectly checks for list emptiness, potentially accessing a type-confused entry to the list_head and leaking the last byte of the confused field that overlaps with rec->tx_ready.

AV.quote: A flaw was found in the Linux Kernel.

C.quote: leaking the last byte of the confused field that overlaps with rec->tx_ready.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request the full vulnerability report or patch/commit details to identify affected kernel versions, exploitability, and remediation steps.
